notes: Achieved occupancy is only 12.25%. The cause is 164 registers/thread: each thread holds its query vector (64 floats) and output accumulator (64 floats) in registers, so few warps fit per SM and there is little latency hiding.

DRAM throughput is 1.51% -- the kernel is nowhere near memory-bound. Combined with the 0.43 long-scoreboard stall, the time goes to exposed load latency that the low occupancy cannot hide, not to bandwidth.

Shared-memory STORE bank conflicts (355,725) are ~10x the load conflicts (35,686): the cooperative K/V staging writes a conflicting layout. A padded shared layout removes them and is the concrete, Nsight-driven fix to try first.
SM (compute) throughput 35% with barrier stalls 0.18 points at the two-__syncthreads-per-tile structure plus the serial per-key online-softmax loop.
interpretation.v2_direction: fp16 WMMA tensor cores restructure the QK^T and AV products into warp-level matrix ops, collapsing the per-thread register arrays (raising occupancy) and halving shared memory (fp16), while a padded shared layout removes the store bank conflicts.
